item.title: Why Melania Trump is denying alleged smears related to Jeffrey Epstein–and wants victims to testify
item.summary: Melania Trump shocked reporters with a live White House speech denying ties to Jeffrey Epstein, calling fake images and smears politically motivated.

item.title: Trump blasts Biden admin for releasing illegal immigrant now charged in fatal hammer attack on Florida mother
item.summary: President blasts Biden for releasing a Haitian immigrant now accused of fatally bludgeoning a woman with a hammer at a Florida gas station last week.

item.title: Inside Tehran after strikes: Iranian woman describes fear, checkpoints and people used as ‘human shields’
item.summary: An anonymous Iranian woman detailed to The Australian the nightly explosions, celebrations and fear in Tehran as Trump's two-week ceasefire with Iran tentatively took hold.

item.title: Hormuz choke point persists as Iran halts oil traffic despite Trump ceasefire
item.summary: The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed despite a ceasefire deal, with 800 tankers among 3,200 vessels backed up and mariners stranded.

item.title: Coast Guard seizes over 4,500 pounds of cocaine worth $34M from suspected narco-terrorist vessel on Easter
item.summary: DHS says the Coast Guard recovered more than 4,500 pounds of cocaine off the coast of Ecuador as part of Operation Pacific Viper counter-drug efforts.

item.title: MAN VS MACHINE: Philadelphians aren't taking kindly to sharing sidewalks with delivery robots
item.summary: Philadelphia residents are clashing with Uber Eats delivery robots, with incidents of kicking and sitting on the autonomous sidewalk couriers reported.

item.title: Suspect who killed California deputy run over by armored vehicle after hours-long firefight standoff: sheriff
item.summary: A California detective was killed in a Porterville shooting while serving an eviction notice, with the suspect allegedly lying in wait, the sheriff says.

item.title: I'm a drone CEO. Our skies are dangerously exposed — here's the solution
item.summary: A Digital Flight Authorization System could replace fragmented drone approval processes with real-time verification of operators and missions.

item.title: Melania Trump's forceful Epstein denial draws bipartisan support from lawmakers
item.summary: First lady Melania Trump denounced allegations tying her to Jeffrey Epstein, prompting bipartisan calls for congressional hearings and accountability.

item.title: School choice is booming and families are winning as the education cartel crumbles
item.summary: As the Trump administration winds down the Department of Education, a school choice revolution gains momentum with over 1.3 million students enrolled.
